siteConfig.title: Renewed Hope National Livestock Carnival 2026
siteConfig.subTitle: Golden Camel & Cow Carnival
siteConfig.tagline: The Sovereign Festival of Culture, Gastronomy, Music & Agribusiness
siteConfig.description: Experience 3 days of grand Durbar equestrian cavalry, live music concerts, open-flame Suya villages, fashion & crafts, purebred livestock auctions, and cutting-edge tech exhibitions.
siteConfig.venue: Abuja National Grounds (Old Parade Ground, FCT)

magazineRows.headline: Grand Durbar Cavalry & Royal Horse Races
magazineRows.body: Witness over 200 ceremonial cavalry war stallions, traditional Northern horsemen, camel pageantry, and royal racing displays in a breathtaking celebration of national heritage.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Royal Durbar Equestrian Cavalry in Abuja

magazineRows.headline: Open-Flame Suya Village & Artisanal Culinary Fest
magazineRows.body: Indulge in Nigeria's largest open-flame grilling arena. Featuring master Suya chefs, artisanal smoked meats, organic spice markets, and family festival dining across beef, lamb, goat, and poultry.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Open-flame Suya Village and Culinary Pavilion

magazineRows.headline: Live Performances, Fashion & Cultural Arts
magazineRows.body: Immerse yourself in live music concerts, traditional masquerades, energetic native dance troupes, contemporary African fashion showcases, and indigenous arts & crafts markets.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Cultural Dance Troupes and Performing Arts in Abuja

magazineRows.headline: Agribusiness, Tech & Fashion Vendor Hub
magazineRows.body: Explore multi-sector commercial pavilions featuring high-tech agricultural machinery, digital livestock e-tagging platforms, fabric and fashion vendors, and direct B2B trade matchmaking.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Fashion, Crafts, Ankara Fabrics and Agribusiness Tech Hub

magazineRows.headline: National Champion Bull & Golden Camel Parade
magazineRows.body: Watch supreme livestock judging competitions across cattle, camels, goats, sheep, and poultry - with electronic live-weight trading demonstrations and purebred genetics showcases from top pastoralists nationwide.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Abuja Animal Carnival Parade and Breed Showcase
